title: An owner answer to a review question is kept twice
what: An owner answer to a review question is kept twice
why: Measured 27 Oct, wt/wave-red: review F5 was a question for the owner; the front recorded it on the item (question 2) and the owner's answer "a" (`relay queue note ... answer`), merged master into the branch, and ran the recheck; the checker still counted F5 as GAP, open 1 ("the owner has not confirmed the form"), because it reads only the review's `owner` list written by `relay check owner`, not the item's answer. The delegate skill (table, row "a question for the owner") asks for both records of the same words, which is principle 3 (derived data is not stored) and principle 10 (one obvious way); one recheck (about 10 minutes, a gate and a checker) was spent on the miss.
failing_case: A review finding of kind question, its answer recorded only as an item note with `to` naming the question: the checker counts it open.
pass_cases: A question finding is linked to its item question (finding id beside the note, or the note naming the finding), and the checker reads the answer from the item; `relay check owner` stays only for findings with no item question (or is removed).
The skill row names one record.
A test with an item answer and no owner list counts the finding as not open, and fails with the item read disabled.
